facts.business: Sreechem Resins Limited manufactures phenol-based resins, allied products, and specialty chemicals, primarily serving refractory units and steel plants.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Management of the Company remains confident that the company shall return to a stronger growth trajectory in the coming year.

key_risks: Volatility in crude oil prices impacting phenol (basic raw material) costs
Intermittent shutdown of HOCL plant leading to erratic phenol supply
Dumping of low-cost refractories and resins from China depressing demand
High customer concentration risk for new products
Depreciation of the Indian rupee increasing input costs
Dependence on few customers for sale of new products
War, coal price changes, and policy changes at customer end affecting production and sales
